method: Isolated Chromium SwiftShader software, 480×320 DPR1, 18 hot samples per state, synchronized gl.finish and readPixels. Source main b8e3540 compared with Mission 22 at matched camera/profile/date and explicitly identical shared time, wind, cloud, sun, lunar and lighting shader fields and deliberately populated public source-route poses. All individual models count against 3/6/10 budgets. Alternating sample order, plus same-build render ablation. Explicit inspected scene, never an ordinary crowd-frequency claim. No other rendering campaign running during this benchmark. No physical GPU or Android claim.
validationStatus: Exploratory campaign rejected for version-regression claims: observer pose and some dynamic landscape owners were not fully matched. Kept for audit; same-build population ablations remain separately identified.
